newsitem.title: CANADA: TransCanada to credit shippers US$38 mln.
newsitem.headline: TransCanada to credit shippers US$38 mln.

text.p: TransCanada Pipelines Ltd said on Thursday that it expects to receive a refund of US$38 million from Great Lakes Gas Transmission Ltd Partnership for excess amounts paid by TransCanada for service on Great Lakes' system.
The National Energy Board approved TransCanada's proposal to pay out the refund to current firm shippers on TransCanada's system.
TransCanada would credit these shippers' monthly invoices for service as soon as possible following TransCanada's receipt of funds, the board said in a statement.
The board also directed TransCanada to allocate the refund among current firm shippers on a fixed volume distance basis.

For the purposes of the Great Lakes' refund, the definition of current firm shippers will include Firm Transportation, Storage Transportation Service and Firm Service Tendered shippers, the board said.

TransCanada is expected to receive the US$38 million refund over a three-year period beginning in 1996. The refund refers to payments made by TransCanada for service on the Great Lakes' system from November 1, 1991 to September 30, 1995.
